- scripts/validate_process.sh:1197 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: Inside `attempt_render_recovery_after_preflight_failure`, `local PRE_FLIGHT_APPEND_LOG="true"` creates a local variable instead of setting the global flag used by `run_preflight_checks`.
  WHY: With the local assignment, the original preflight log is truncated on rerun and the failure diagnostics are lost, which harms self-healing and debugging.
